title: Ridawan Lai Gaiyan Ghazi Ty Bhena Be Rida Ho Gaiyan
body:
Teri Lash To Alma Walaya Veerna Kiwain Juda Ho Gayain
<<DIVIDER>>
Tu Laran Day Layee Paband Sain Jiwain
Asi Ron Day Layee Paband Veerna
Teri Maqtalgah Day Haye Vicho Paakay Rasiyan
Qaidana Bekhata Ho Gaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Jina Bawaan Day Utay Sanu Maan Si Baray
O Bawaan Teriyan Leh Gaiyan Veerna
Tu Neher Tay Jaakay Saam Gaya
Parday Daaran Bay Aasra Ho Gaiyan
<<DIVIDER>>
Asi Shaam Di Taraf Padal Na Jandiyan
Jai Deen Day Faraz Honday Na Veerna
Tere Gham Vich Ghazi Vekh Laye
Rahwaan Vi Farshay Azaa Ho Gayian
<<DIVIDER>>
Ankh Khol Kay Jadon Abid Ne Vekhya
Na Khaimay Saday Raye Na Chadraan Veerna
Ehnu Ghairatan Khaa Laiya Tay
Marzaan Ehdiyan La Daawa Ho Gaiyan
